name: Last Day at School
source:
It is your last day at school. Will something change after this?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161209160231/http://renai.us/game/Last_day.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
今天是你在學校的最後一天。過了今天，有什麼會變得不一樣嗎？

[譯自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161209160231/http://renai.us/game/Last_day.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
